source_snapshot.criteria: No errors or hang; CPU watts should match the max.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; adds affinity, signed max-watt oracle, low-rail/dew-point and RAS controls.

old_problem: Pending values were CPU topology/profile, environmental limits and an owner-definable maximum-power oracle.
disposition_reason: ED-03 binds topology/profile, ED-09 keeps chamber work manual, ED-14 preserves 12 hours, and ED-15 requires the max-watt domain/statistic/target/tolerance to be signed before PASS rather than guessed.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row55 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3089 and actual next row56/history3090 were read.
Socket-affined load and core/NUMA/sensor mapping prove both CPUs are exercised.
The 'max watts' requirement remains mandatory but is a runtime oracle binding, not an invented numeric value.
Per-socket frequency/power/throttle/RAS is correlated to dry 0C/-5% telemetry; no action ran.

test_case.purpose: Verify CPU0 and CPU1 sustain signed load and maximum-power behavior for 12 hours at cold/low-rail margin without compute, throttle-policy, RAS or platform failure.
required_package: Pinned stress profile and per-socket load floor
Low-rail/dew-point thermal/RAS abort and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions, run the approved socket-affined 12-hour profile on both CPUs, capture per-socket load/frequency/power/thermal/throttle/RAS, then warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: Both sockets meet signed load and max-watt criteria for the full interval with no disallowed compute, RAS, thermal, heartbeat or platform event.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both sockets and a pre-approved watt oracle; aggregate utilization or a guessed 'max' cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified chamber/rail operator and calibrated sensors
Abort on moisture, power/thermal, RAS or heartbeat limit
test_case.recovery: Stop on a signed limit, preserve evidence, return rails nominal, warm/dry, restore CPU policy and do not auto-retry.
